record.body:
## Rationale

detail.test.ts R14 asserts the phase target from detailTarget, and deepLinks.test.ts R2 asserts a data-detail=phase element. R25 needs the leaf-view tests unchanged, and test_ui_structure.py pins the hash of deepLinks.test.ts. A separate leafTarget keeps both files as they are and still mounts no dialog for the phase.

## Counter-argument

Two target functions can drift apart. The design named the single function. Mitigation: leafTarget wraps detailTarget and only filters the phase kind.

payload.alternatives: detailTarget returns null for the phase (as the design says)
payload.choice: detailTarget keeps returning the phase target. A new leafTarget returns null for the phase and the dialog uses it. The phase page root keeps data-detail=phase.

record.subject: phase-target-kept
